init.title: FFBB Tracker Options
init.description: Set how often data refreshes, and optionally speed things up around match time to get the score as soon as it's published.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to check for updates outside of match periods (15 to 1440 minutes).
data_description.live_polling: Automatically switches to a shorter interval as a match approaches and until the result is published.
data_description.live_scan_interval: Check frequency once fast polling kicks in (2 to 15 minutes).
data_description.live_window_after_hours: How long fast polling keeps running after the match start time while waiting for the score (1 to 6 hours).

refresh.name: Refresh data
refresh.description: Force an immediate coordinator refresh for FFBB teams.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Specific config entry to refresh. If omitted, all tracked teams are refreshed.

get_next_matches.name: Get next matches
get_next_matches.description: Return upcoming matches for automations or scripts.
